theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 3rd on momentum with the strongest durability (0.76) and best breadth (0.90), but crowding_z 1.82 is the highest in the eligible set — flagged crowded. Guardrails forbid fading or selling on crowding; the honest expression of that caution at desk level is to avoid adding, not to underweight. Rank supports attention, not a call, and crowding is coincident texture.
theses.dissent: Strong uptrend with high durability and broad participation can keep running despite crowding; momentum leaders often stay crowded longer than expected (reflexivity).

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 20-day high and crowding_z mean-reverts back below 1.0, showing the trend is absorbing positioning.

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: AI Semiconductors shows the strongest durability (0.85) and widest breadth (0.917) in the eligible set, with a clean trend tag and moderate crowding_z 0.69. The absolute-trend gate — the one validated edge — argues for staying with trends that are still healthy. Momentum score is middling (1.083), so this is a durability/trend-gate lean, not a rank chase.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend gate validated on this market)
theses.dissent: AI Semiconductors overlaps heavily with the crowded Memory/HBM complex via SMH proxy; if the HBM/memory trade reverses on supply news, AI semis get hit as a correlated cluster regardless of their own breadth.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its 50-day moving average and AI Semiconductors' durability_bar falls under 0.60, signaling the trend gate has flipped.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is eligible with broad participation (breadth 0.917) and the lowest crowding_z in the top ranks (-0.06, not crowded). It sits mid-board on momentum (rank 7) but benefits from a geopolitical macro backdrop (unscheduled_share 1.0, geopolitics among dominant themes) that is coincident, not a trigger. Lean rests on durable, uncontested trend + tail-risk backdrop, not momentum rank.
evidence: macro_narrative: geopolitics among dominant themes, unscheduled_share 1.0
theses.dissent: If the macro backdrop normalizes (de-escalation) Gold Miners can mean-revert hard; gold miners have high equity beta and no fundamental edge of their own beyond metal price direction.

falsifier.text: GDX breaks below its 200-day moving average while the gold spot price stays flat, showing miners are losing relative strength.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
